items.title: Brent oil tops $90 | Trump threatens more strikes on Iran | Happiest Minds, TBZ stocks in focus
items.summary: Higher oil prices weigh on market sentiment. Brent tops $90 on West Asia uncertainties. Trump threatens further strikes on Iran following Jordan attacks. US August Non-Farm payroll report in focus on Friday. US 10 year yield rises to 4.78% on geo-political & inflation concerns. Gold slips to near 2 week lows on Fed rate hike worries. Asian markets trade mixed; Gift Nifty indicates cautious start for India. Nifty under pressure on Monday but manages to close above 24000. Nifty Bank Sees Major CAS Adjustment, Ends 600 Pts Higher Vs 3:15 pm level. Q1 GDP growth zooms past estimates at 7.8%, GVA Growth At 8.2%. Q4 FY26 GDP growth revised sharply higher from 7.8% to 8.6%. FIIs Net Sell Rs 7,985.88 Cr In Equities. DIIs Net Buy Rs 4,588.88 Cr In Equities

items.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: GIFT Nifty hints a negative start; US markets down, Asia gains
items.summary: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: US stocks weakened on Monday, with Wall Street turning the page on a volatile ​month as a war-related jump in crude prices revived inflation fears and raised the likelihood of tighter monetary policy. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 374.09 points, or 0.70%, to 53,185.90, the S&P 500 lost 25.62 points, or 0.33%, to 7,686.14 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 31.53 points, or 0.12%, to 26,370.89.
